CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_actor_scope(_uid uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(profile_ok boolean, org_partner uuid, user_partner uuid, user_partner_count integer, partner_valid boolean, has_catalog boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH pr AS (
    SELECT o.partner_account_id
      FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = p.organization_id
     WHERE p.user_id = _uid AND p.ativo = true AND o.ativo = true AND o.status = 'ativa'
     LIMIT 1
  ), pu AS (
    SELECT count(*)::int c, min(partner_id::text)::uuid pid
      FROM public.partner_users
     WHERE user_id = _uid AND revoked_at IS NULL
  ), valid AS (
    -- Caminho fornecedor: vínculo só resolve o parceiro com a cadeia completa
    -- perfil→organização→tenant→proprietário comprovada no servidor.
    SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT c FROM pu) = 1
                 AND public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(_uid, (SELECT pid FROM pu))
                 AND EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                     FROM public.partner_users puv
                     JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = puv.partner_id
                     JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
                     JOIN public.profiles pf ON pf.user_id = puv.user_id
                     JOIN public.organizations porg ON porg.id = pf.organization_id
                    WHERE puv.user_id = _uid
                      AND puv.partner_id = (SELECT pid FROM pu)
                      AND puv.revoked_at IS NULL
                      AND (puv.valid_from IS NULL OR puv.valid_from <= now())
                      AND pf.ativo = true
                      AND porg.ativo = true AND porg.status = 'ativa'
                      AND pf.organization_id = puv.tenant_id
                      AND puv.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
                      AND pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
                      AND owner.ativo = true AND owner.status = 'ativa'
                 )
              THEN (SELECT pid FROM pu) END AS pid
  )
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr),
         -- Organização com parceiro explícito prevalece; sem ela, o vínculo autorizado
         -- validado resolve o parceiro. Se ambos existirem e divergirem, org_partner
         -- permanece o da organização e os consumidores negam por mismatch.
         COALESCE((SELECT partner_account_id FROM pr), (SELECT pid FROM valid)),
         (SELECT pid FROM valid),
         (SELECT c FROM pu),
         CASE WHEN (SELECT partner_account_id FROM pr) IS NOT NULL
              THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pr.partner_account_id
                            WHERE pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL)
              ELSE (SELECT pid FROM valid) IS NOT NULL END,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid) e WHERE e.feature_key = 'catalogo_precos');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_commercial_context()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); org uuid; pid uuid; rs text[]; result jsonb; BEGIN
 org:=public.h15_actor_organization();
 SELECT partner_id INTO pid FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=u;
 IF NOT public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(u,pid) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(role::text ORDER BY role::text) INTO rs FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=u;
 result:=jsonb_build_object('contract','C2_MULTIPROFILE_V1','actor_id',u,'tenant_id',org,
 'organization_id',org,'partner_id',pid,'commercial_owner_organization_id',org,'external_roles',rs,
 'role',CASE WHEN 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs) THEN 'parceiro_b2b' ELSE 'parceiro_b2b_tecnico' END,
 'papel',CASE WHEN 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs) THEN 'gestor' ELSE 'tecnico' END,'mode','commercial_owner',
 'manager', 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs),'technician','parceiro_b2b_tecnico'=ANY(rs),
 'producer_links_valid',platform_private.c2_producer_links(u,org),
 'profile_stamp',(SELECT updated_at FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=u),
 'link_version',(SELECT version FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=u));
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_internal_commercial_actor()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND public.h15_actor_organization() IS NOT NULL AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(auth.uid()) AND (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id=auth.uid() AND r.role IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico')); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_internal_origin_valid(s jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_typeof(s)='object' AND s->>'schema_version'='1'
 AND nullif(s->>'organization_id','') IS NOT NULL
 AND s->>'organization_id'=s->>'creditor_organization_id'
 AND s->>'organization_id'=s->>'issuer_organization_id'
 AND nullif(s->>'company_settings_id','') IS NOT NULL
 AND nullif(s->>'actor_user_id','') IS NOT NULL
 AND nullif(s->>'partner_id','') IS NOT NULL,false)
$function$

 RETURNS boolean

 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_order_internal_recipients(_partner uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id
    FROM public.partner_accounts pa
    JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND o.status = 'ativa'
    JOIN public.profiles p ON p.organization_id = o.id AND p.ativo IS TRUE
    JOIN public.user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = p.user_id
   WHERE pa.id = _partner AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND ur.role IN ('administrador'::public.app_role,'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_order_partner_recipients(_partner uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT DISTINCT pu.user_id
    FROM public.partner_users pu
    JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pu.partner_id AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
    JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id = pu.user_id AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND p.organization_id = pu.tenant_id
   WHERE pu.partner_id = _partner AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL
     AND (pu.valid_from IS NULL OR pu.valid_from <= now())
     AND public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(pu.user_id, pu.partner_id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_owner_order_create_allowed(_uid uuid, _partner uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT false; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_owner_plan_assigned(_partner uuid, _plan uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT public.fn_b2b_plan_selectable(_plan) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_payment_plan_assignments a
     WHERE a.plan_id = _plan AND a.partner_id = _partner
       AND a.buyer_scope = 'partner' AND a.status = 'published'
       AND a.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (a.valid_until IS NULL OR a.valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_producer_links(p_user uuid, p_org uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p_user)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id
 JOIN public.user_clientes uc ON uc.user_id=p.user_id JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=uc.cliente_id
 JOIN public.fazendas f ON f.cliente_id=c.id
 WHERE p.user_id=p_user AND p.organization_id=p_org AND p.ativo AND o.ativo AND o.status='ativa'
 AND uc.is_active AND uc.revoked_at IS NULL AND uc.valid_from<=now()
 AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until>=now())
 AND c.organization_id=p_org AND c.status_cliente='ativo' AND f.organization_id=p_org AND f.ativo);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(p_scope text, p_partner uuid, p_customer uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE(CASE
 WHEN p_scope='partner' AND p_partner IS NOT NULL AND p_customer IS NULL THEN EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
 WHERE pa.id=p_partner AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL AND owner.ativo IS TRUE AND owner.status='ativa'
 AND owner.id=platform_private.c2p1_internal_actor(ARRAY['administrador','financeiro','gestor_comercial']::public.app_role[]))
 WHEN p_scope='producer' AND p_partner IS NULL AND p_customer IS NOT NULL THEN EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes c JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=c.organization_id
 WHERE c.id=p_customer AND c.status_cliente='ativo' AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND o.status='ativa'
 AND o.id=platform_private.c2p1_internal_actor(ARRAY['administrador','financeiro','gestor_comercial']::public.app_role[]))
 ELSE false END,false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_internal_actor(p_roles app_role[])
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT public.h15_actor_organization() WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id
 WHERE p.user_id=auth.uid() AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND o.status='ativa'
 AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p.user_id))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=auth.uid() AND role=ANY(p_roles))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=auth.uid()
 AND role IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico','cliente_produtor'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(p_assignment uuid, p_plan uuid, p_scope text, p_partner uuid, p_customer uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(p_scope,p_partner,p_customer) AND
 (p_assignment IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_payment_plan_assignments a
 WHERE a.id=p_assignment AND a.plan_id=p_plan AND a.buyer_scope=p_scope
 AND a.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner AND a.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer
 AND platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(a.buyer_scope,a.partner_id,a.customer_id)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_settings_allowed(p_partner uuid, p_write boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa JOIN public.organizations o
 ON o.id=platform_private.c2p1_internal_actor(CASE WHEN p_write THEN
 ARRAY['administrador','financeiro','gestor','gestor_comercial']::public.app_role[] ELSE
 ARRAY['administrador','financeiro','gestor','gestor_comercial','administrativo']::public.app_role[] END)
 WHERE pa.id=p_partner AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND o.status='ativa' AND
 (o.partner_account_id=pa.id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.organizations owner
 WHERE owner.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id AND owner.id=o.id AND owner.ativo IS TRUE AND owner.status='ativa')));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_settings_fence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR NOT platform_private.c2p1_settings_allowed(NEW.partner_id,true)
 OR NOT platform_private.has_ticket('c2p1_settings_write',NEW.partner_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_SETTINGS_WRITE_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.partner_id
 OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.payment_methods WHERE active IS TRUE AND name=NEW.default_payment_method)<>1
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_PAYMENT_METHOD_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF NEW.credit_limit::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.credit_limit<0
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1 NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2 NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1>NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FINANCIAL_VALUES_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.h15_actor_organization()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT p.organization_id FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id AND o.ativo IS TRUE WHERE p.user_id=auth.uid() AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p.user_id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.has_ticket(_scope text, _target uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets
                 WHERE txid = txid_current() AND scope = _scope AND target = _target);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.issue_ticket(_scope text, _target uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  INSERT INTO platform_private.authz_tickets(txid, scope, target)
  VALUES (txid_current(), _scope, _target) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id=p_user AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND p.senha_provisoria IS FALSE)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.platform_org_admin_invites i WHERE i.user_id=p_user AND (i.access_operation_status='processing' OR (i.access_valid_after IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid()=p_user AND to_timestamp(COALESCE((auth.jwt()->>'iat')::bigint,0))<=i.access_valid_after)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_apply_interest(p_net numeric, p_interest_type text, p_monthly_pct numeric, p_months numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_interest_type = 'none' OR COALESCE(p_monthly_pct,0) = 0 OR COALESCE(p_months,0) = 0
      THEN ROUND(p_net,2)
    WHEN p_interest_type = 'simple'
      THEN ROUND(p_net * (1 + (p_monthly_pct/100.0) * p_months), 2)
    ELSE ROUND(p_net * POWER(1 + (p_monthly_pct/100.0), p_months), 2)
  END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_cart_hash(p_partner_id uuid, p_plan_id uuid, p_cart jsonb, p_final numeric)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(
    'v2|' || COALESCE(p_partner_id::text,'-') || '|' || COALESCE(p_plan_id::text,'-') || '|' ||
    to_char(ROUND(COALESCE(p_final,0),2),'FM9999999999990.00') || '|' ||
    COALESCE((
      SELECT string_agg(
        COALESCE(l->>'item_tipo','')      || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'item_id','')        || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'unidade_medida','') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'volume_ml')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'quantidade')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'pricing_mode','')   || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'price_source','')   || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'rule_id','')        || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'final_unit_price')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'line_final_amount')::numeric,0),2),'FM9999999999990.00'),
        ';' ORDER BY COALESCE(l->>'item_tipo',''),
                     COALESCE(l->>'item_id',''),
                     COALESCE(l->>'unidade_medida',''),
                     COALESCE((l->>'volume_ml')::numeric,0),
                     COALESCE((l->>'quantidade')::numeric,0),
                     COALESCE(l->>'rule_id',''))
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_cart->'lines','[]'::jsonb)) l
    ),'') || '|' ||
    COALESCE((p_cart->>'quote_required'),'false')
  ,'UTF8')),'hex')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_credit_exposure(p_partner_id uuid, p_new_order_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_exclude_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_limit numeric(14,2); v_open numeric(14,2); v_overdue numeric(14,2);
  v_committed numeric(14,2); v_pending numeric(14,2);
  v_new numeric(14,2) := ROUND(COALESCE(p_new_order_amount,0),2);
  v_proj numeric(14,2); v_disp numeric(14,2); v_pct numeric;
  v_tolerance int; v_block boolean; v_action text; v_reason text;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(credit_limit,0), COALESCE(overdue_tolerance_days,0),
         COALESCE(block_if_overdue,false), COALESCE(credit_limit_action,'block')
    INTO v_limit, v_tolerance, v_block, v_action
  FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id;
  v_limit := COALESCE(v_limit,0); v_tolerance := COALESCE(v_tolerance,0);
  v_block := COALESCE(v_block,false); v_action := COALESCE(v_action,'block');

  -- (a) recebiveis em aberto do parceiro
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_open
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE');

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_overdue
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    AND ari.due_date < (current_date - v_tolerance);

  -- (b) pedidos com compromisso financeiro real e SEM recebivel gerado
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_committed
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega',
                      'confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  -- (c) H4-001: pedidos vivos ainda nao aprovados ja consomem limite.
  --     Sem isso, N pedidos em analise passavam individualmente no teste
  --     de credito e estouravam o limite ao serem aprovados.
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_pending
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('pendente','solicitado','em_analise_comercial',
                      'aguardando_aprovacao_credito','aguardando_ajuste_comercial',
                      'aguardando_itens')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  v_proj := ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending + v_new, 2);
  v_disp := GREATEST(v_limit - v_proj, 0);
  v_pct  := CASE WHEN v_limit > 0 THEN ROUND((v_proj / v_limit) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END;

  v_reason := CASE
    WHEN v_block AND v_overdue > 0 THEN 'OVERDUE_BLOCK'
    WHEN v_limit <= 0 THEN 'NO_LIMIT_DEFINED'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit AND v_action = 'approval_required' THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_APPROVAL'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BLOCK'
    ELSE 'OK' END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'partner_id', p_partner_id,
    'credit_limit', v_limit,
    'saldo_em_aberto', v_open,
    'saldo_vencido', v_overdue,
    'comprometido_nao_faturado', v_committed,
    'comprometido_pendente', v_pending,
    'novo_pedido', v_new,
    'exposicao_atual', ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending, 2),
    'exposicao_projetada', v_proj,
    'credito_disponivel', v_disp,
    'percentual_utilizado', v_pct,
    'overdue_tolerance_days', v_tolerance,
    'block_if_overdue', v_block,
    'credit_limit_action', v_action,
    'tem_vencidos', v_overdue > 0,
    'reason_code', v_reason
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_order_priceable(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(po.status::text <> 'aguardando_cotacao'
              AND COALESCE(po.payment_condition_status,'') <> 'quote_required'
              AND COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0) > 0
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_payment_terms t
                          WHERE t.partner_order_id = po.id AND t.final_amount > 0)
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_items i
                              WHERE i.order_id = po.id
                                AND COALESCE(i.pricing_mode_snapshot,'') = 'quote_only'), false)
  FROM public.partner_orders po WHERE po.id = p_order_id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_plan_selectable(_plan_id uuid, _ref timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_payment_plans p
    WHERE p.id = _plan_id
      AND p.active = true
      AND p.superseded_by_id IS NULL
      AND p.valid_from <= _ref
      AND (p.valid_until IS NULL OR p.valid_until > _ref)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6_guard_ar_installment_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.receivable_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.receivable_id
     OR NEW.installment_number IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.installment_number
     OR NEW.original_amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.original_amount
     OR NEW.due_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.due_date
     OR NEW.net_amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.net_amount
     OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Parcela imutavel: titulo, numero, valor original, vencimento, valor liquido e data de criacao nao podem ser alterados.'
      USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6_guard_title_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.total_amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total_amount
     OR NEW.installment_count IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.installment_count
     OR NEW.origin_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.origin_type
     OR NEW.origin_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.origin_id
     OR NEW.issue_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.issue_date
     OR NEW.first_due_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.first_due_date
     OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by
     OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Snapshot financeiro imutavel: valor, parcelas, origem e datas de emissao nao podem ser alterados.'
      USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
  END IF;

  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'accounts_receivable'
     AND (to_jsonb(NEW)->>'payment_method_id') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)->>'payment_method_id') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Condicao/metodo do titulo e imutavel apos a criacao: use o metodo na baixa (receivable_payments).'
      USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6d_block_hard_delete()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_partner_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL) <> 1 THEN NULL
           WHEN bool_or(pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
                        AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
                        AND pu.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
                        AND pu.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id)
                FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL)
           THEN (array_agg(pu.partner_id) FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL))[1]
         END
  FROM public.partner_users pu
  LEFT JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pu.partner_id
  WHERE pu.user_id = auth.uid();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(p_user_id uuid, p_partner_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p_user_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id
 JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.user_id=p.user_id
 JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=pu.partner_id
 JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
 WHERE p.user_id=p_user_id AND pa.id=p_partner_id AND p.ativo AND o.ativo AND o.status='ativa'
 AND owner.ativo AND owner.status='ativa' AND pa.ativo AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND p.organization_id=pu.tenant_id AND pu.tenant_id=owner.id
 AND (o.partner_account_id IS NULL OR o.partner_account_id=pa.id)
 AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL AND pu.valid_from<=now())
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=p_user_id)=1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND role IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico'))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND role NOT IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico','cliente_produtor'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_audit_partner_order_commercial()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.priority IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.priority OR NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
    INSERT INTO public.commercial_audit_log(usuario_id, partner_id, order_id, acao, dados_anteriores, dados_novos)
    VALUES (
      auth.uid(), NEW.partner_id, NEW.id, 'partner_orders.commercial_change',
      jsonb_build_object('status', OLD.status, 'priority', OLD.priority),
      jsonb_build_object('status', NEW.status, 'priority', NEW.priority)
    );
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_block_partner_order_edit_after_op()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_locked boolean;
BEGIN
  v_locked := public.partner_order_has_production(OLD.id);
  IF NOT v_locked THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- Campos sempre permitidos
  -- status, ready_for_production, approved_by, approved_at, approval_notes,
  -- estimated_delivery_date, observacoes, updated_at, future_financial_link

  IF NEW.subtotal IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.subtotal
     OR NEW.desconto_total IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.desconto_total
     OR NEW.total IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total
     OR NEW.partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.partner_id
     OR NEW.numero IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.numero
     OR NEW.requested_delivery_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requested_delivery_date
  THEN
    INSERT INTO public.partner_order_audit_logs (order_id, partner_id, usuario_id, acao, dados_anteriores, dados_novos)
    VALUES (OLD.id, OLD.partner_id, auth.uid(), 'edicao_bloqueada',
            to_jsonb(OLD), to_jsonb(NEW));
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Este pedido já possui Ordem de Produção vinculada e não pode mais ser alterado.';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_block_pofl_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Rollback controlado: somente administrador e somente apos cancelamento
  -- canonico do recebivel (cancel_b2b_receivable_secure).
  IF COALESCE(OLD.financial_status, '') = 'cancelado'
     AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
     AND public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::app_role) THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vínculo financeiro não pode ser excluído';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_partner_order_items_resolve_pending()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_status partner_order_status;
  v_pid uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT status, partner_id INTO v_status, v_pid
    FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id = NEW.order_id FOR UPDATE;

  IF v_status = 'aguardando_itens' THEN
    UPDATE public.partner_orders
       SET status = 'em_analise_comercial',
           itens_pendentes_resolvido_em = now(),
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE id = NEW.order_id
       AND status = 'aguardando_itens';

    INSERT INTO public.partner_order_audit_logs(order_id, partner_id, usuario_id, acao, dados_anteriores, dados_novos)
    VALUES (NEW.order_id, v_pid, auth.uid(), 'items_added',
            jsonb_build_object('status','aguardando_itens'),
            jsonb_build_object('status','em_analise_comercial','item_id', NEW.id));
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_partner_order_to_planning_fn()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.ready_for_production = true AND (OLD.ready_for_production IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.ready_for_production) THEN
    INSERT INTO public.production_planning (partner_order_id, partner_id, status, created_by)
    VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.partner_id, 'aguardando_planejamento', NEW.approved_by)
    ON CONFLICT (partner_order_id) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO public.production_timeline_events (partner_order_id, event_type, actor_id, meta)
    VALUES (NEW.id, 'planejamento_criado', NEW.approved_by, jsonb_build_object('approved_at', NEW.approved_at));
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
